title: 'Abasa 80:1-8 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 13 (Pupil PDF worksheet: 'Abasa 80:1-8 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 13. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ (١) أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ (٢) وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ (٣) أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ (٤) أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ (٥) فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ (٦) وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ (٧) وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ (٨)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: The Prophet frowned and turned away
Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].
But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified
Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?
As for he who thinks himself without need,
And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.
But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Ikhfa: ج; then madd before hamza

questions.q: Chunk and link 'Abasa 80:1-8 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 80:1-8 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 80:1-8 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: In the portal box, write one lesson about how to treat people from 80:1 to 10.
questions.a: Value people for their sincerity and taqwa, not wealth or status.

questions.q: Find all four ikhfa examples in 80:1 to 8.
What did the blind man come seeking (80:8 to 9)?
questions.a: A) To learn, fearing Allah. 80:8 to 9: he came striving, and he fears Allah. The ayat praise his sincerity.

questions.q: Think again: A poor, blind man comes to ask about Islam while you are busy with important people. What would you do, and why?
questions.a: Allah taught that the sincere seeker deserves our full attention: worth is in the heart, not status (80:1 to 10).
